name: prompt-to-ship
description: From prompt to shipped change, in any language and on any git host. Every request becomes a precise brief, gets a plan reviewed by a fixed architect and product expert (plus a UI specialist on a visible change; a small change takes a quick lane), is built with proof, reviewed in layers (fresh, security, validation) and delivered as a change request. It also debugs shipped code, read-only, and starts a new project from an idea, git included. A built-in design skill shapes new screens and checks every visible change against a tier list. You merge, or the pipeline merges within fixed gates if you choose so. A lesson worth keeping becomes a new rule.
